findings.text: Maid Atelier 是 DSH Web 皮肤，面向偏好该视觉风格并希望改善窄屏操作的用户。当前增量集中在设置导航溢出提示、移动侧栏关闭交互和视觉适配；任务主体仍是对话与阅读，收益依赖偏好和宿主布局。
设置导航根据可见列表溢出写提示属性；视口小于 1024px、侧栏打开时，切换会话或外部点击会关闭抽屉并阻止点击落到背后控件。弹层和拖动手势保留自身处理。逻辑依赖宿主 DOM 选择器，不能作为跨版本运行证明。
读取本轮固定组件源码、既有目录统计及上一版本研究；未安装或运行插件，未执行宿主、浏览器、外部服务或真实用户验证。
固定子包 manifest 为 0.1.10，声明公开 npm 包和宿主 peer 范围。本次未核对该提交对应的发行字节或 dist-tag。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 包下载和图片缓存，实际用量未知 | 核对版本、渠道和许可 | 真实部署未验收 |
| 持续 | 观察器、绘制和合成，未计量 | 升级宿主后复查控件 | 无任务节省数据 |
| 失败恢复 | 重载与重复下载可能消耗资源，未计量 | 查源图、错误报告和残留 | 服务注销不清浏览器缓存 |
偏好该视觉风格且常用窄屏 DSH Web 的用户可在测试 profile 试用。先验证会话切换、外部点击、弹层/拖动、设置溢出及禁用后恢复；若出现误关、背景误触、重要控件遮挡或卸载后残留，就回到默认主题并停用。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q04](#research-q04)

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 主题视觉 | 组合独立装饰、明暗素材和表格视图 | 用户偏好与实际阅读舒适度 |
| 错误页 | 匹配固定报告后加样式，保留正文 | 新宿主布局和诊断可读性 |
| 退出 | 源码释放监听并恢复部分状态 | 实际浏览器和并发写入下的恢复 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 的图片服务只读明列文件，降低对外部资源的依赖。[Q03](#research-q03) 的错误标记用多所有者租约回收，可用于其它共享 DOM 装饰，但仍需针对宿主选择器验证真实启停。
皮肤把视觉元素和窄屏交互接到宿主。macOS 侧栏填充是本版本变化，导航与抽屉是继续保留的机制。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02)
移动抽屉和设置导航依赖宿主 DOM 选择器与事件时序；宿主结构变化、弹层或拖动手势可能引发误关/误触。视觉主题本身也可能降低部分用户的阅读偏好或可访问性；当前没有目标浏览器、窄屏设备与禁用清理的运行证据。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
待验证假设：窄屏用户频繁切换会话时，自动收起抽屉且吞掉落到背景的点击，能减少误操作而不妨碍弹层与拖动。用 1024px 两侧断点、会话切换、外部点击、弹层/拖动和设置溢出任务与默认界面对照，记录误触、完成时间与禁用后残留；若误操作未减少或弹层受损则推翻。[Q04](#research-q04)

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 声明范围内的 DSH Web 与布局面 | 皮肤加载需要 | 挂载客户端并找到目标 DOM | 切回默认并核对实际宿主 |
| 两端 JS、资源清单及包内图片 | 完整主题需要 | 提供同源图像和样式 | 先核对包与 Host 路由 |
| 匹配的安装渠道和皮肤管理器 | 作者建议 | 管理选择和设置 | 已有聚合生态时用其适配版 |
| 作者声明的美术使用条件 | 使用前核对 | 约束资源使用 | 条件不明时保留默认界面 |

technical.rationale: Novelty 9/35（25%）：主题皮肤和窄屏导航属常见界面适配；当前提交的外部点击关闭与误触吞 click 是具体局部改进，maid-atelier/src/client/mobile-drawer.ts:1–27 可核对，未形成新通用布局方法。Mechanism 8/30（25%）：监听窄屏、会话行、弹层、拖动及吞 click 的事件组合见 mobile-drawer.ts:90–154；这是细致实现但没有突破宿主 UI 机制，取25%。Transferability 10/20（50%）：设置溢出观察和 disposer 可借鉴到相似客户端（settings-navigation.ts:35–84），但选择器依赖 DSH DOM，跨宿主未验证，取50%。Simplification 8/15（50%）：自动收抽屉和溢出提示减少手动关闭/猜测入口，但皮肤仍增加资源与兼容维护；未显著减少整体设置流程。依据 [Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)。

business.rationale: Workflow 9/35（25%）：会话阅读/设置任务本身不变，只改窄屏关闭与导航提示（Q01–Q02）；局部操作便利超过零增量，未改变分工或交接，故25%。Delivery 8/30（25%）：附加的移动交互和溢出提示改善已有界面，不产生新的业务交付；实现为具体便利但效用未经用户验证。Reach 5/20（25%）：针对窄屏 DSH Web 和偏好该主题的人群（Q01），仅进入较窄的界面使用场景，没有打开原本不可达的工作。Economics 4/15（25%）：没有费用/人时证据；代码提供自动处理局部操作但新增宿主兼容和素材维护成本，最多支持小幅成本结构变化。

recommendation.reason: 偏好该视觉主题且常用窄屏的 DSH Web 用户可在测试配置检查会话切换和设置导航。相比默认主题，它额外提供移动抽屉自动关闭与溢出提示。若点击误触、诊断遮挡或禁用后残留，就切回默认主题并重载。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 指出偏好主题及窄屏用户、会话切换任务和默认界面基线，mobile-drawer.ts:1–27 描述具体摩擦，超过没有适用需求的0档。回答没有用户频次或反复摩擦后果，也未证明用户愿意承担皮肤兼容成本；只支持25%（8/30），未到50%档。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) 与 mobile-drawer.ts:90–154、settings-navigation.ts:35–84 支持窄屏抽屉自动关闭、吞掉误触点击和导航溢出提示，较默认主题有具体机制增量，超过局部入口包装档。宿主 DOM 匹配和真实设备操作效果未验证，是否实质改善仍不确定，按50%（13/25）而非75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) 有固定源码说明断点、事件分类、观察器和 disposer，并有包入口/资源白名单证据，能覆盖机制和依赖，达到源码级50%档。没有浏览器/设备执行或本地测试证据，故不超过13/25。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04) 显示可在测试配置试用，customization.ts:87–171 与 mobile-drawer.ts:149–162 提供监听撤销路径，超过恢复/退出缺失档。实际宿主生命周期、维护和素材核验尚未验证，需用户承担版本适配与检查，未达75%档，取50%（10/20）。

# Maid Atelier > 为 DSH Web GUI 提供深海女仆主题、随对话区变化的装饰与宽表格展开。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale) - **版本号**：0.1.11（[固定提交 811fa53b712a16ce5f5278529bb76d5a033a1d13](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/tree/811fa53b712a16ce5f5278529bb76d5a033a1d13)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-13（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 核心贡献 皮肤把视觉元素和窄屏交互接到宿主。macOS 侧栏填充是本版本变化，导航与抽屉是继续保留的机制。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) ## 关键质疑 移动抽屉和设置导航依赖宿主 DOM 选择器与事件时序；宿主结构变化、弹层或拖动手势可能引发误关/误触。视觉主题本身也可能降低部分用户的阅读偏好或可访问性；当前没有目标浏览器、窄屏设备与禁用清理的运行证据。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 待验证假设：窄屏用户频繁切换会话时，自动收起抽屉且吞掉落到背景的点击，能减少误操作而不妨碍弹层与拖动。用 1024px 两侧断点、会话切换、外部点击、弹层/拖动和设置溢出任务与默认界面对照，记录误触、完成时间与禁用后残留；若误操作未减少或弹层受损则推翻。[Q04](#research-q04) 在目标宿主隔离环境按 [Q04](#research-q04) 逐项执行小规模任务，记录失败、质量、人工时间与资源成本；任一停止条件触发则回滚。 ## 场景与替代办法 Maid Atelier 是 DSH Web 皮肤，面向偏好该视觉风格并希望改善窄屏操作的用户。当前增量集中在设置导航溢出提示、移动侧栏关闭交互和视觉适配；任务主体仍是对话与阅读，收益依赖偏好和宿主布局。 基线为手工完成相同任务或旧研究固定版本；没有同条件效果测量。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 声明范围内的 DSH Web 与布局面 | 皮肤加载需要 | 挂载客户端并找到目标 DOM | 切回默认并核对实际宿主 | | 两端 JS、资源清单及包内图片 | 完整主题需要 | 提供同源图像和样式 | 先核对包与 Host 路由 | | 匹配的安装渠道和皮肤管理器 | 作者建议 | 管理选择和设置 | 已有聚合生态时用其适配版 | | 作者声明的美术使用条件 | 使用前核对 | 约束资源使用 | 条件不明时保留默认界面 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 用户核对兼容范围、包和素材条件 | 同一个测试 profile 只用适配的发行 | | 激活 | 由宿主加载皮肤并取得本地图片 | 背景、会话内容和输入均可见 | | 验收 | 用户切明暗、用键盘展开和退出长表格 | 可读可操作，诊断可见 | | 退出 | 停用并回到默认主题 | 输入、表格与样式恢复，必要时重载 | ## ## 安装

> [!NOTE]
> 如果你用的是 dsh-web（装过 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`），请直接在 dsh-web 自带的皮肤中心里安装 `maid-atelier` 和 `orca-link`，不要再运行下面的命令。两边的皮肤是分别适配的，装在同一个 profile 里会让界面显示错乱。

### 官方桌面版

1. 按需选择一套或多套皮肤。打开侧栏「插件」，点击「添加插件」，逐个填入下面对应的 npm 包名并安装。

   | 插件 | npm 包名 |
   |---|---|
   | [maid-atelier](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-maid-atelier) | `@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-maid-atelier` |
   | [orca-link](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link) | `@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link` |
   | [皮肤管理器](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager) | `@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager` |

2. **只装一套皮肤**时，管理器可选；不装就无法使用配置面板、图形化版本兼容放行和自动多皮肤互斥管理。**同时装多套皮肤必须安装并保持管理器启用**，否则皮肤同时启用会让界面错乱。管理器一旦安装，即使只用一套皮肤也应保持启用。安装完成后按提示启用插件，然后**重启一次 DSH**。
3. 如果安装了皮肤管理器，重启后打开「设置 → 皮肤管理」。首次启动若仍显示官方界面，到这里选择要启用的皮肤即可。

想用 `main` 上的最新代码，也可以按所选皮肤和管理器，在同一个安装框里逐个填入对应的 GitHub 地址（只填地址，不加 `dsh plugin add`）：

```text
github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/skin-manager
github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/maid-atelier
github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/orca-link
```

在默认配置下，DSH 捆绑的 pnpm 11.7.0 优先选择发布满 24 小时的 npm 版本。想立即安装某个刚发布的新版，可以在同一个「添加插件」框里填入 `包名@^版本号`，例如 `@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link@^0.1.11`（不加命令前缀）。这次显式 `add` 会安装新版，并把具体版本写入 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`，依赖仍保持 caret 范围。此行为对应捆绑版本及默认配置，其他 pnpm 版本或自定义策略可能不同。GitHub 来源不受这项 npm 包龄检查影响。

桌面版通过应用管理自己的 `desktop` profile，不需要先配置 `dsh` 命令。下面的 `web` 命令不会给桌面版安装皮肤。

### CLI 安装的 Web 版

本页命令以 `web` profile 为例；如果你启动的是其他 CLI profile，请把命令中的 `web` 换成对应名称。

皮肤可以从 npm 或 GitHub 安装，两种来源装的是同一套皮肤，区别在于更新节奏：

| | npm（推荐） | GitHub |
|---|---|---|
| 拿到的版本 | 正式发布的版本，有固定版本号 | `main` 分支上的最新代码 |
| 什么时候能用上修复 | 通常在发版约 24 小时后（DSH 内置 pnpm 的默认包龄策略） | 修复合并后马上就能装 |
| 网络 | 可以配置 npm 镜像源，国内一般更稳 | 需要能访问 GitHub |

拿不准就选 npm。复制对应系统的命令运行即可，不需要 clone 仓库。

**从 npm 安装**

```sh
# Linux / macOS / WSL
dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager' && dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-maid-atelier' && dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link'
```

```powershell
# PowerShell
dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager'; dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-maid-atelier'; dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link'
```

**从 GitHub 安装**

```sh
# Linux / macOS / WSL
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/skin-manager' && dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/maid-atelier' && dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/orca-link'
```

```powershell
# PowerShell
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/skin-manager'; dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/maid-atelier'; dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#main&path:/orca-link'
```

两种来源用的是同一个包名，后装的会替换先装的。想从一种换到另一种，直接用另一组命令重新装一遍即可。

装好后**重启一次 DSH**。如果装了管理器，打开「设置 → 皮肤管理」，在想用的皮肤上点「切换」。之后换皮肤都是即时生效，不用再重启。

- 只装一套皮肤时，可以删掉另一套皮肤和管理器的 `add`；不装管理器就无法使用配置面板、图形化版本兼容放行和自动多皮肤互斥管理。管理器一旦安装就应保持启用；同时装多套皮肤必须安装并保持管理器启用，避免皮肤同时启用。
- 两套都装了的话，首次重启后界面还是官方默认的样子，这是正常的：两套皮肤同时启用会互相打架，管理器会先把它们都关掉，等你来选。
- 不想自己敲命令，可以把这句话发给任意 AI（或 DSH 本身），它会按 [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) 帮你装好：

  ```
  读取 https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/INSTALL.md 并按其中的指引安装本仓库皮肤
  ```

## 更新

**桌面版：**截至 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，插件页没有升级入口，也不会自动更新第三方插件。在「插件」列表卸载要更新的插件，再按上面的步骤重新安装并启用，完成后重启 DSH。

**CLI Web 版：**只保留你实际安装的包名。

```sh
# Linux / macOS / WSL
dsh plugin --profile web update @smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager @smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-maid-atelier @smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link
```

```powershell
# PowerShell
dsh plugin --profile web update '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager' '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-maid-atelier' '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link'
```

这条命令对 npm 和 GitHub 两种来源都适用：npm 来源会更新到最新发布的版本，GitHub 来源会拉取 `main` 上的最新代码。更新后刷新页面即可，不需要重启 DSH。如果这个 profile 里只装了本仓库的皮肤，也可以直接运行 `dsh plugin --profile web update` 更新全部插件。

在默认配置下，DSH 内置的 pnpm 11.7.0 优先选择发布满 24 小时的 npm 版本，所以 `update` 可能仍停在旧版。要立即安装某个新版，可以显式 `add` 包名加 `@^版本号`：pnpm 会安装新版，并把具体版本写入 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`，依赖仍保持 caret 范围。其他 pnpm 版本或自定义策略可能不同。版本号见 [Releases](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/releases)：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link@^0.1.11'
```

版本号前的 `^` 不要省：省掉后会固定在这个版本，以后的 `update` 就不会再升级了。

## 遇到问题

**升级 DSH 后皮肤不见了**

每套皮肤声明支持的 DSH 版本范围（当前支持 0.2.2-rc.3 至 0.2.2 正式版）。DSH 升级到更新的版本而皮肤还没跟上时，DSH 会自动停用皮肤、恢复官方界面，免得皮肤把输入框之类的控件挡住。

先按上面的更新说明更新皮肤。如果还没有新版，又想先用着旧皮肤，可以打开「设置 → 皮肤管理」：被停用的皮肤会显示「未声明支持当前的 DSH x.y.z，已被自动停用」，点「切换」并确认即可。这个放行只针对当前的皮肤版本和 DSH 版本，任意一方升级后会重新检查；用得不顺手随时切回「官方默认」。

<details>
<summary>用命令行放行</summary>

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web allow-version @smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-orca-link@<皮肤版本> --dsh-version <DSH 版本> --accept-risk
```

</details>

**界面乱了：设置按钮不见、侧栏宽度异常、装饰叠在一起**

多半是两套皮肤同时在运行。打开「设置 → 皮肤管理」，点「官方默认」或任意一套皮肤，刷新页面即可恢复。如果连设置都打不开，展开下方的[皮肤互斥原理](#mutual-exclusion)，按其中的方法手动修复。

**装了但页面没变化**

先刷新浏览器；仍然没有的话，去「设置 → 皮肤管理」确认目标皮肤处于启用状态。

更多情况见下方的[常见安装报错](#install-errors)。

本地开发，或者想测试某个指定提交时，可以 clone 仓库后按目录安装：

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale
node <clone 的绝对路径>/.agents/skills/dsh-skin-install/scripts/stage-mutual-exclusion.mjs --profile web --target maid-atelier
dsh plugin --profile web add <clone 的绝对路径>/skin-manager
dsh plugin --profile web add <clone 的绝对路径>/maid-atelier
dsh plugin --profile web add <clone 的绝对路径>/orca-link
```

- 第二行 `node` 命令可以跳过。它的作用是提前选好默认皮肤，让第一次启动直接就是这套皮肤；`--target` 可以写 `maid-atelier`、`orca-link` 或 `official`（官方默认）。跳过的话，首次启动是官方界面，再去皮肤管理里切换即可。
- 路径请尽量写**绝对路径**，Windows 下正斜杠、反斜杠都行，例如 `C:/Users/<你>/code/dsh-deep-whale/maid-atelier`。
- 不要只写目录名：`dsh plugin --profile web add maid-atelier` 会被当成 npm 包名去下载，结果 404。相对路径要以 `./` 或 `../` 开头，并且是相对于你**运行 dsh 命令时所在的目录**，不是皮肤仓库目录；路径算错时命令不会报错，但皮肤不会生效。
- 本地目录和 npm、GitHub 来源用的是同一个包名，以最后一次 `add` 为准。

</details>

<details>
<summary><a name="mutual-exclusion"></a><b>皮肤互斥原理</b></summary>

同一时间只能启用一套皮肤；皮肤管理器本身不算皮肤，安装后需要一直开着。同时安装多套皮肤时，必须安装并保持管理器启用来管理互斥。

每套皮肤的开关记录在两个配置文件里：`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`（profile 层，`<profile>` 为 `web` 或桌面版的 `desktop` 等实际名称）和 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`（home 层，优先级更高）。文件里没有写某套皮肤时，它默认是**开启**的，所以一次装两套又从没切换过，它们就会同时运行，导致界面错乱。

皮肤管理器会处理这件事：

- 每次启动时，如果发现有两套以上皮肤同时开着，会把它们全部关掉、回到官方默认，已经选好的单套皮肤不受影响；
- 在「设置 → 皮肤管理」里切换时，会自动把开关写进两个配置文件并即时生效。

管理器用不了时，可以手动修改。把下面的内容**同时**加到上面两个文件里，想启用哪套，就把哪套设为 `false`，另一套设为 `true`：

```yaml
- id: ui-skin-maid-atelier
  disabled: false
- id: ui-skin-orca-link
  disabled: true
- id: ui-skin-deep-whale-manager
  disabled: false
```

如果文件还是 DSH 的默认模板（几行注释加一行 `[]`），请用上面的内容**替换掉** `[]` 那一行，否则文件格式会出错。也可以运行上一节的 `stage-mutual-exclusion.mjs` 自动写好，或者用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove <包名>` 直接卸掉不用的皮肤。

皮肤的个性化设置（例如「定时隐藏立绘」的生效时段）保存在当前浏览器里，由管理器统一应用。

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>确认安装是否成功</b></summary>

**桌面版：**在「插件」列表确认所装的包已出现，重启后查看皮肤效果；装了管理器的，再到「设置 → 皮肤管理」选择皮肤。桌面版的 `desktop` profile 不支持 CLI 的 `--dump-config`，无需运行下面的命令。

**CLI Web 版：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web list          # 应该能看到你选择安装的包
dsh --profile web --dump-config        # 所选皮肤应为 disabled: false；如装了管理器，也应为 false
```

刚装完、还没重启时，两套皮肤可能都显示为启用，这是正常的，重启后管理器会处理。

重启后还可以在浏览器控制台运行下面这行，确认页面确实加载了皮肤脚本：

```js
document.documentElement.outerHTML.match(/\/plugins\/@smalltailqwq\/[^"'\s]+/g) ?? []
```

结果里应包含当前启用的皮肤，以及你安装并启用的管理器；停用的皮肤不出现是正常的。

</details>

<details>
<summary><a name="install-errors"></a><b>常见安装报错</b></summary>

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404` | 包名拼错、网络不通，或本地安装时只写了目录名 | 直接复制本页的包名；本地安装改用绝对路径 |
| `The matching commit...` / 无法解析 ref | pnpm 版本低于 9，不支持 `#path:` 写法 | 升级 pnpm：`npm i -g pnpm@latest` |
| `ERR_PNPM_EXOTIC_SUBDEP` | 试图安装一个会再拉取 Git 依赖的聚合包（pnpm 11 的安全限制，本仓库不提供这类包） | 按本页命令分别安装三个包 |
| `pnpm not found on PATH` | 没有安装 pnpm | `npm i -g pnpm` 后重试 |
| 包已安装但页面没变化 | 皮肤处于停用状态，或浏览器没刷新 | 在皮肤管理里启用它，然后刷新页面 |
| PowerShell 命令不完整或报错 | 包名没加引号，`#` 后面被当成注释截掉了 | 包名一律用单引号包住 |

</details>

      "content": "/**
 * `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` closes its narrow sidebar only from the
 * toggle button. Two gestures a phone user expects are therefore missing:
 *
 * 1. picking a session calls `openSession`, which never touches
 *    `narrowExpanded`, so the drawer keeps covering the conversation after a
 *    session switch and has to be closed by hand;
 * 2. tapping outside the open drawer does nothing at all — the host's
 *    `overlayLayer` is only an overlay container (`pointer-events: none`, no
 *    handler), not a scrim, so the drawer stays up until the toggle is found
 *    again.
 *
 * Both are mirrored here: a row activation closes the overlay on the next
 * frame, and a pointer that lands outside the open column dismisses it. The tap
 * that dismisses is then swallowed, because on a phone the control behind the
 * drawer is usually the composer — and its send button sits exactly in the
 * corner a reader aims at when dismissing.
 *
 * A settings dialog opened from the drawer is deliberately *not* a dismissal:
 * closing one surface must not close another the reader opened. The drawer
 * stays where it was and the dialog closes on its own.
 *
 * The breakpoint mirrors `SIDEBAR_AUTO_COLLAPSE` in the layout package: below it
 * the collapsed column is a rail and the expanded column is an overlay, above it
 * the column is docked and must stay open.
 */
const DRAWER_AUTO_COLLAPSE = 1024
const SIDEBAR_COLUMN_SELECTOR = "[class*='sidebarCol']"
const SESSION_ROW_SELECTOR = '[data-maid-session-row], [role="treeitem"][class*="sessionRow"]'
const ROW_AFFORDANCE_SELECTOR = '[role="menu"], [role="dialog"], input, textarea, [aria-haspopup]'
/** Popups own the tap that dismisses them, so the drawer waits its turn. */
const OPEN_POPUP_SELECTOR = [
  '[role="menu"]',
  '[role="listbox"]',
  '[role="dialog"]',
  '[aria-modal="true"]',
  '[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]',
  '[data-floating-ui-portal]',
].join(',')
/** The host's resize handle is a drag, not a dismissal. */
const DRAG_HANDLE_SELECTOR = "[class*='handle']"
/** How long a dismissing pointer keeps swallowing the click it produced. */
const SWALLOW_WINDOW_MS = 400

/**
 * Close the narrow sidebar when a session row (or the sidebar's New Session
 * button) is activated, and when a tap lands outside the open drawer.
 * @param body - skin owning element (document.body); supplies the document and view.
 * @returns disposer removing the listeners installed here.
 */
export function installMaidMobileDrawerAutoClose(body: HTMLElement): () => void {
  const doc = body.ownerDocument
  const view = doc.defaultView
  if (view === null) return () => {}
  let pendingFrame: number | null = null
  let swallowTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null

  const drawerOpen = (): boolean => view.innerWidth < DRAWER_AUTO_COLLAPSE
    && doc.querySelector('div[data-sidebar-collapsed]') === null
    && (doc.querySelector(SIDEBAR_COLUMN_SELECTOR)?.getBoundingClientRect().width ?? 0) > 0

  const closeDrawer = (): void => {
    if (!drawerOpen()) return
    doc.querySelector(SIDEBAR_COLUMN_SELECTOR)
      ?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("button[class*='toggle']")
      ?.click()
  }

  /** Gestures that keep the drawer open: its own chrome, a popup, a drag handle. */
  const ownsGesture = (target: Element): boolean => target.closest(SIDEBAR_COLUMN_SELECTOR) !== null
    || target.closest(ROW_AFFORDANCE_SELECTOR) !== null
    || target.closest(DRAG_HANDLE_SELECTOR) !== null
    || doc.querySelector(OPEN_POPUP_SELECTOR) !== null

  /** Dismiss the drawer for a gesture outside it; true when it was open to close. */
  const dismissOutside = (target: Element): boolean => {
    if (!drawerOpen() || ownsGesture(target)) return false
    closeDrawer()
    return true
  }

  const armSwallow = (): void => {
    if (swallowTimer !== null) clearTimeout(swallowTimer)
    swallowTimer = setTimeout(() => { swallowTimer = null }, SWALLOW_WINDOW_MS)
  }

  const releaseSwallow = (): boolean => {
    if (swallowTimer === null) return false
    clearTimeout(swallowTimer)
    swallowTimer = null
    return true
  }

  const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent): void => {
    // Secondary buttons and extra touches during a pinch are not dismissals.
    if (event.isPrimary === false || event.button > 0) return
    // A new gesture must not inherit suppression from a dismissal with no click.
    releaseSwallow()
    const target = event.target
    if (!(target instanceof Element) || !dismissOutside(target)) return
    armSwallow()
  }

  const onPointerCancel = (event: PointerEvent): void => {
    if (event.isPrimary !== false) releaseSwallow()
  }

  const onMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent): void => {
    // Cancelling the default focus keeps a dismissing tap from raising the phone
    // keyboard on the composer behind the drawer.
    if (swallowTimer !== null) event.preventDefault()
  }

  const onClick = (event: MouseEvent): void => {
    const target = event.target
    if (!(target instanceof Element)) return

    // The pointerdown that dismissed the drawer already did the work: swallow the
    // click it produced so it cannot activate the control behind the overlay.
    if (releaseSwallow()) {
      event.preventDefault()
      event.stopPropagation()
      return
    }

    // Synthetic clicks (no pointerdown) still dismiss; for a real pointer the
    // drawer is already closed by now, so this is a no-op.
    if (drawerOpen() && dismissOutside(target)) return

    // Row-internal affordances (overflow menu, inline rename, popovers) own the
    // gesture and keep the drawer open.
    if (target.closest(ROW_AFFORDANCE_SELECTOR) !== null) return
    const row = target.closest(SESSION_ROW_SELECTOR)
    const newSession = target.closest<HTMLElement>("button[class*='newSession']")
    if (row === null && newSession === null) return
    if (target.closest(SIDEBAR_COLUMN_SELECTOR) === null) return
    // A row carries a nested "Session actions" control that has no aria-haspopup,
    // so it is recognised structurally instead.
    const control = target.closest('button, [role="button"], a')
    if (control !== null && row !== null && control !== row && row.contains(control)) return
    if (!drawerOpen() || pendingFrame !== null) return
    // Let the host apply the selection first, then close the overlay.
    pendingFrame = view.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      pendingFrame = null
      closeDrawer()
    })
  }

  doc.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, true)
  doc.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel, true)
  doc.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown, true)
  doc.addEventListener('click', onClick, true)
  return () => {
    doc.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, true)
    doc.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel, true)
    doc.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown, true)
    doc.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true)
    if (pendingFrame !== null) view.cancelAnimationFrame(pendingFrame)
    pendingFrame = null
    releaseSwallow()
  }
}

const NAV_SELECTOR = "[data-slot='sidebar.settings'] > [role='presentation'] > [role='dialog'] > nav, "
  + "body > [role='presentation'] > [role='dialog'][data-shortcut-modal='settings'] > nav"
const MORE_ATTRIBUTE = 'data-maid-settings-more'
interface SettingsNavigation {
  synchronize: () => void
  dispose: () => void
}

const installations = new WeakMap<Document, { users: number, controller: SettingsNavigation }>()

/** The existing settings observer calls synchronize when the host replaces its navigation. */
export function createMaidSettingsNavigation(body: HTMLElement): SettingsNavigation {
  const doc = body.ownerDocument
  let installation = installations.get(doc)
  if (installation === undefined) {
    installation = { users: 0, controller: createNavigation(body) }
    installations.set(doc, installation)
  }
  const current = installation
  current.users += 1
  let active = true
  return {
    synchronize: () => { if (active) current.controller.synchronize() },
    dispose: () => {
      if (!active) return
      active = false
      if (--current.users > 0) return
      current.controller.dispose()
      installations.delete(doc)
    },
  }
}

function createNavigation(body: HTMLElement): SettingsNavigation {
  let active = true
  let nav: HTMLElement | null = null
  let list: HTMLElement | null = null
  let originalMore: string | null = null
  let writtenMore: string | null = null
  let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined

  const update = (): void => {
    if (!active || nav === null || list === null) return
    const more = list.scrollHeight - list.clientHeight - Math.max(0, list.scrollTop) > 1
    writtenMore = more ? '' : null
    if (nav.getAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE) === writtenMore) return
    if (writtenMore === null) nav.removeAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE)
    else nav.setAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE, writtenMore)
  }

  const detach = (): void => {
    resizeObserver?.disconnect()
    resizeObserver = undefined
    list?.removeEventListener('scroll', update)
    if (nav !== null && nav.getAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE) === writtenMore) {
      if (originalMore === null) nav.removeAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE)
      else nav.setAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE, originalMore)
    }
    nav = null
    list = null
  }

  const synchronize = (): void => {
    if (!active) return
    const nextNav = body.querySelector<HTMLElement>(NAV_SELECTOR)
    const nextList = nextNav?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(':scope > :last-child') ?? null
    if (nav !== nextNav || list !== nextList) {
      detach()
      nav = nextNav
      list = nextList
      originalMore = nav?.getAttribute(MORE_ATTRIBUTE) ?? null
      writtenMore = originalMore
      if (list !== null) {
        try {
          list.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true })
          if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(update)
            resizeObserver.observe(list)
          }
        } catch (error) {
          detach()
          throw error
        }
      }
    }
    update()
  }

  const dispose = (): void => {
    if (!active) return
    active = false
    detach()
  }
  return { synchronize, dispose }
}

//#region ../shared/skin-assets.ts
/** Public, immutable artwork only. Paths come from the shipped allowlist, never from disk traversal. */
function installSkinAssets(ctx, id, directory, files) {
	const prefix = `/skin-assets/${id}`;
	const allowed = new Set(files);
	ctx.inject(["webServer"], (webCtx) => {
		const server = webCtx.get("webServer");
		webCtx.effect(() => server.register({
			kind: "prefix",
			path: prefix,
			handler: async (req, res) => {
				if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD") {
					res.writeHead(405, { Allow: "GET, HEAD" }).end();
					return;
				}
				const pathname = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost").pathname;
				const file = pathname.slice(prefix.length + 1);
				if (!pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`) || !allowed.has(file) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}\.(png|webp)$/.test(file)) {
					res.writeHead(404).end();
					return;
				}
				let bytes;
				try {
					bytes = await readFile(new URL(file, directory));
				} catch (error) {
					if (error.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
					res.writeHead(404).end();
					return;
				}
				const etag = `"${file.split(".")[0]}"`;
				const headers = {
					"Content-Type": file.endsWith(".webp") ? "image/webp" : "image/png",
					"Cache-Control": "public, max-age=31536000, immutable",
					"X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
					ETag: etag
				};
				if (req.headers["if-none-match"]?.split(",").some((value) => value.trim().replace(/^W\//, "") === etag || value.trim() === "*")) {
					res.writeHead(304, headers).end();
					return;
				}
				res.writeHead(200, {
					...headers,
					"Content-Length": bytes.length
				});
				res.end(req.method === "HEAD" ? void 0 : bytes);
			}
		}), `${id}: packaged artwork`);
	});
}

const ATTR_FONT = 'data-dsh-whale-maid-font'
const ATTR_WORKSPACE_FONT = 'data-dsh-whale-maid-workspace-font'
const ATTR_MODEL_EXIT = 'data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit'
const ATTR_MODEL = 'data-dsh-whale-model'
const ATTR_FLASH_GLASSES = 'data-dsh-whale-maid-flash-glasses'
const ATTR_COMPOSER_MODE = 'data-maid-composer-mode'
const ATTR_COMPOSER_BOTTOM_ONLY = 'data-maid-composer-bottom-only'
const ATTR_NAV_MODE = 'data-maid-nav-mode'
const ATTR_PLAIN_PROCESS = 'data-maid-plain-process'
const ATTR_SIDEBAR_LACE = 'data-maid-sidebar-lace'
/** Navigation layouts the stylesheet implements; anything else falls back to the default. */
const NAV_MODES = new Set(['corner', 'topbar', 'rail'])

const WORKSPACE_FONTS = new Set(['serif', 'system', 'conversation'])

// Keep the original banner height unless the user chooses a compact layout.
const WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_DEFAULT = 54
const WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_MIN = 22
const WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_MAX = 54
const WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_PROPERTY = '--maid-workspace-row-height'

/** Restore the original inline value and priority only while this writer owns it. */
class SkinPropertyProjector {
  private readonly originals = new Map<string, { value: string, priority: string }>()
  private readonly owned = new Map<string, string>()

  constructor(private readonly root: HTMLElement = document.documentElement) {}

  set(name: string, value: string): void {
    if (!this.originals.has(name)) {
      this.originals.set(name, {
        value: this.root.style.getPropertyValue(name),
        priority: this.root.style.getPropertyPriority(name),
      })
    }
    this.root.style.setProperty(name, value)
    this.owned.set(name, value)
  }

  release(): void {
    for (const [name, original] of this.originals) {
      if (this.root.style.getPropertyValue(name) === this.owned.get(name)
        && this.root.style.getPropertyPriority(name) === '') {
        if (original.value === '') this.root.style.removeProperty(name)
        else this.root.style.setProperty(name, original.value, original.priority)
      }
    }
    this.originals.clear()
    this.owned.clear()
  }
}

function workspaceRowHeight(value: SkinSettingValue | undefined): number {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_DEFAULT
  return Math.min(WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_MAX, Math.max(WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_MIN, Math.round(value)))
}

function sceneBrightness(value: SkinSettingValue | undefined): string {
  const percent = typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 80
  return String(Math.min(100, Math.max(60, percent)) / 100)
}

/**
 * The lineup is DeepSeek Flash and DeepSeek Pro, so the display name only
 * decides which side the artwork sits on. Both families carry vision now: the
 * glasses artwork is a separate switch (`flashGlasses`) instead of a `vision`
 * substring match, which used to split an older V4 name into a third family.
 */
export function modelFamily(name: string): 'pro' | 'flash' | null {
  const compact = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
  if (!compact.includes('deepseek')) return null
  if (compact.includes('pro')) return 'pro'
  if (compact.includes('flash')) return 'flash'
  return null
}

/** Expose controls and keep every resulting DOM mutation skin-owned. */
export function installMaidCustomization(root: HTMLElement = document.documentElement): () => void {
  const projector = new SkinAttributeProjector(root)
  const properties = new SkinPropertyProjector(root)
  let observer: MutationObserver | undefined
  let frame: number | undefined
  let activeState: SkinCustomizationState | null = null
  let mobile = window.innerWidth <= 700

  const synchronizeModel = (): void => {
    let family: ReturnType<typeof modelFamily> = null
    for (const trigger of document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-composer-card] button[aria-haspopup='menu']")) {
      family = modelFamily(`${trigger.title} ${trigger.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? ''} ${trigger.textContent ?? ''}`)
      if (family !== null) break

    if (family === null) projector.unset(ATTR_MODEL)
    else projector.set(ATTR_MODEL, family)
  }

  const scheduleModelSync = (): void => {
    if (frame !== undefined) return
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      frame = undefined
      synchronizeModel()
    })
  }

  const startModelObserver = (): void => {
    if (observer !== undefined) return
    observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
      if (records.some(record => {
        const element = record.target instanceof Element ? record.target : undefined
        if (record.type === 'childList' && element?.closest('[data-composer-input]')) return false
        if (record.type === 'attributes') return element?.matches("button[aria-haspopup='menu']") === true
        if (element?.closest("[data-composer-card] button[aria-haspopup='menu']")) return true

            || node.querySelector("[data-composer-card], button[aria-haspopup='menu']"))

      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['aria-label', 'title'],
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,

    observer = undefined
    if (frame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(frame)
    frame = undefined
    projector.release(ATTR_MODEL)
  }

    if (activeState === null) return

      properties.release()

    const scheduleVisible = state.visibility.sfwMode !== false
    projector.set(ATTR_ART, artwork && scheduleVisible ? 'visible' : 'hidden')
    projector.set(ATTR_FONT, state.values.font === 'serif' ? 'serif' : 'system')
    const workspaceFont = state.values.workspaceFont
    projector.set(ATTR_WORKSPACE_FONT, typeof workspaceFont === 'string' && WORKSPACE_FONTS.has(workspaceFont) ? workspaceFont : 'serif')
    projector.set(ATTR_FLASH_GLASSES, state.values.flashGlasses === true ? 'on' : 'off')
    synchronizeModelMode()
    projector.set(ATTR_COMPOSER_MODE, typeof state.values.composerMode === 'string' ? state.values.composerMode : 'persistent')
    projector.set(ATTR_COMPOSER_BOTTOM_ONLY, state.values.composerBottomOnly === true ? 'on' : 'off')
    const navMode = state.values.mobileNav
    projector.set(ATTR_NAV_MODE, typeof navMode === 'string' && NAV_MODES.has(navMode) ? navMode : 'corner')
    properties.set(WORKSPACE_ROW_HEIGHT_PROPERTY, `${workspaceRowHeight(state.values.workspaceRowHeight)}px`)
    properties.set('--maid-scene-brightness-light', sceneBrightness(state.values.sceneBrightnessLight))
    projector.set(ATTR_PLAIN_PROCESS, state.values.plainProcess === true ? 'on' : 'off')
    projector.set(ATTR_SIDEBAR_LACE, state.values.sidebarLace === false ? 'off' : 'on')
  }

    protocol: SKIN_CUSTOMIZATION_PROTOCOL,
    skinId: 'maid-atelier',
    title: '深海女仆工坊',
    titleEn: 'Abyssal Maid Atelier',

    groups: [

  --dsw-alias-state-business-tertiary: #293d73;
  --dsw-specific-input-major: rgba(17, 30, 66, 0.88);
  --dsw-specific-selector: rgba(45, 64, 111, 0.9);
  --dsw-specific-sidebar-fill: rgba(5, 13, 40, 0.9);
  --dsw-alias-label-primary-foreground: #091333;
  --dsw-alias-button-primary-fill: #9bb0e1;
  --dsw-alias-button-primary-hover: #b7c6e8;
  --dsw-alias-state-error-primary: #ff8e98;
  --dsw-alias-state-error-secondary: #ff8e98;
  --dsw-alias-link: #b7c6e8;
  --dsw-alias-label-dimmed: #7f90b4;
  --dsw-alias-markdown-tag: #293f78;
  --dsw-alias-bg-module-platform: #20315b;
  --dsw-specific-menu: var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3);
  --dsw-alias-label-primary-dimmed: #e7ecf7;
  --dsw-alias-label-primary-inverted: #091333;
  --dsw-alias-menu-icon: #d5dff3;
  --dsw-alias-button-contrast-fill: #e7ecf7;
  --dsw-alias-button-ghost-active-fill: #293f78;
  --dsw-alias-button-ghost-active-hover: #354d88;
  --dsw-alias-button-ghost-active-border: #96a6c9;
  --dsw-alias-button-primary-dimmed: #293f78;
  --dsw-alias-state-success-primary: #79cca4;
  --dsw-alias-state-success-secondary: #79cca4;
  --dsw-alias-state-success-tertiary: #123e30;
  --dsw-alias-state-warn-primary: #f0cf8c;
  --dsw-alias-state-warn-secondary: #f0cf8c;
  --dsw-alias-state-warn-label: #f0cf8c;
  --dsw-alias-state-warn-tertiary: #45371b;
}

/* Fallback, not an adaptation: the client marks the page when a plugin has
   replaced the official root layout. The palace stage and sidebar art never
   mount there, so the translucent surfaces above would show the plain page or
   the conversation straight through a drawer. Keep the palette, drop the
   transparency, and leave that layout's own structure alone. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-shell='foreign'] {
  --dsw-alias-bg-base: #e7edf8;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1: #f5f7fc;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-2: #ebf0fa;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-3: #e0e7f6;
  --dsw-specific-sidebar-fill: #0b1942;
  /* Portaled menus drop from the header's navy band, where the host's
     translucent menu fill turned grey under dark ink. */
  --dsw-specific-menu: var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-ds-dark-theme][data-maid-shell='foreign'] {
  --dsw-alias-bg-base: #0a132f;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1: #121f43;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-2: #182850;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-3: #20315b;
  --dsw-specific-sidebar-fill: #050d28;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [id='root'] {
  position: relative;
  background: transparent;
}

/* shell.overlay 浮层面板永远高于皮肤装饰层:视觉与点击都不被顶帘/装饰遮挡。
   overlayLayer 自带 z-index 20,这里抬到 1000 是为彻底避开任何皮肤层
   (装饰 chrome 0 / 应用 chrome 21 / 角色 -1..1) 与第三方插件对 #root 的
   层叠上下文抬升,保证挂载在 shell.overlay 槽的浮动面板(如文件浏览器)
   在视觉与点击层级上始终位于皮肤之上。 */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-shell-overlay] {
  /* Overlay surfaces need an opaque base even when the conversation is transparent. */
  --dsw-alias-bg-base: #e7edf8;
  z-index: 1000;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-ds-dark-theme] [data-shell-overlay] {
  --dsw-alias-bg-base: #0a132f;
}

/* The native leading seat must clear the decorated header (21), while staying
   below fullscreen panels (40) and shell overlays. Host clearance owns spacing. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-shell-leading] {
  z-index: 22;
}

/* The palace and both maids live INSIDE the conversation column: the stage is
   an absolutely positioned first child (z-index 0) whose box IS the chat area,
   so any layout push — a right/bottom workbench squeezing the center column —
   moves and re-fits the artwork with the chat instead of leaving it fixed to
   the viewport. The palace rides the --maid-palace-art custom property from
   the client entry; the maids seat at the stage's bottom corners and scale
   with its height (% of the stage), never with the viewport. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='character-stage'] {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  contain: strict;
  /* Palace scaling policy: `cover` keeps the art's aspect ratio and fills the
     stage on both axes by scaling to the WIDER axis — a wide chat area shows
     the art edge-to-edge horizontally and crops the vertical overflow, while
     a chat area narrower than the art's ratio keeps the art full-height and
     crops the horizontal overflow (no shrink-to-width in narrow windows).
     Position `center bottom` anchors the overhanging axis to the BOTTOM edge,
     which is the line the maids stand on. `cover` outgrows the stage
     vertically as soon as the chat area is wider than the palace's 1.5988:1,
     and a centered anchor then cuts the same amount off the top and the bottom:
     the palace's own ground edge lands below the visible bottom, the floor is
     cut in half, and the maids read as standing inside it. */
  background: var(--maid-palace-art) center bottom / cover no-repeat;
}

/* The conversation column is the stage's containing block. It stays
   z-index auto (no new stacking context), so fixed popups keep their
   page-level tier. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='centerCol'] {
  position: relative;
}

/* The ConversationRoot is the column's in-flow content. `position: relative`
   without a z-index lifts it into the positioned band AFTER the stage in DOM
   order, so chat rows, the header and the composer paint above the artwork
   while fixed popups inside it keep painting at page level. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='centerCol']
  :is([data-phase='hero'], [data-phase='active'], [data-phase='settling']) {
  position: relative;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character] {
  position: absolute;
  display: block;
  z-index: 1;
  width: auto;
  max-width: none;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 20px 24px rgba(27, 44, 91, 0.14));
  transition:
    translate 620ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.78, 0.2, 1),
    bottom 620ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.78, 0.2, 1),
    height 620ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.78, 0.2, 1),
    opacity 420ms ease;
}

/* Both maids anchor at the bottom corners of the chat area and size against
   its height. The edge offsets stay small so the artwork never collides with
   the transcript column (max 748px, centered) in a wide chat. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character='left'] {
  bottom: 0;
  left: clamp(8px, 1.5%, 24px);
  height: 96%;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  :is([data-maid-character='right'], [data-maid-character='vision']) {
  right: clamp(8px, 1.5%, 24px);
  bottom: 0;
  height: 92%;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character='vision'] {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-ds-dark-theme] [data-maid-character] {
  filter:
    brightness(0.84)
    saturate(0.92)
    drop-shadow(0 22px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
}

/* All active conversation views share the same figure size and opacity, so
   switching between Chat and Trajectory leaves the artwork in place. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-conversation-active]
  [data-maid-character='left'] {
  height: 64%;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-conversation-active]
  :is([data-maid-character='right'], [data-maid-character='vision']) {
  height: 62%;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character] {
    opacity: 0.74;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  /* Height-sized portrait art can be wider than the phone's conversation
     pane. Fit the whole figure inside its side anchor with room opposite it. */
  html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled']
    body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character] {
    max-width: calc(100% - 48px);
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-conversation-active]
    [data-maid-character='left'] {
    height: 46%;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-conversation-active]
    :is([data-maid-character='right'], [data-maid-character='vision']) {
    height: 44%;
  }

}

/* Keep portrait-phone landing figures below the headline and clear of the
   composer. Active conversations include inspection views as well as chat. */
@media (max-width: 700px) and (orientation: portrait) {
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]:not([data-maid-conversation-active])
    [data-maid-character] {
    height: 62%;
    opacity: 0.66;
  }
}

/* A continuously changing layout — a viewport resize, the sidebar opening
   or closing, or a right/bottom workbench pushing the conversation column —
   gives transitions a new destination every frame. Follow the resize
   directly, then restore state-change motion.

   The filters stay. The chat column's ResizeObserver holds this marker for
   every sidebar toggle, and dropping `filter` here made the figures lose their
   grade and soft shadow for exactly that long: a brightness flash in the dark
   theme and a flickering halo in the light one. Software renderers already
   drop the filters for good through `data-maid-low-power` below. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-layout-resizing]
  [data-maid-character] {
  transition: none;
}

/* Chromium rejects failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat when it would fall back to a
   software renderer. Keep large transparent character layers cheap there. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-low-power]
  [data-maid-character] {
  filter: none;
  transition: opacity 180ms ease;
}

/* The family manager projects browser-local preferences onto html. Keeping
   them outside the skin runtime means hot switching cannot leak listeners or
   timers into a later activation. */
html[data-dsh-whale-maid-art='hidden']
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  [data-maid-character] {
  opacity: 0 !important;
  visibility: hidden;
}

html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='pro']
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  :is([data-maid-character='right'], [data-maid-character='vision']) {
  translate: 100vw 0;
  opacity: 0;
}

html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='flash']
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  [data-maid-character='left'] {
  translate: -100vw 0;
  opacity: 0;
}

/* Two maids standing side by side need 1.08 x the chat area's height of width
   (their intrinsic ratios, see the corner rules above). A right sidebar narrows
   the chat area without shortening it — the viewport rules further down cannot
   see that — so the client entry measures the room between the two boxes and
   marks the body while they no longer fit. One maid then leaves the way the
   model-exit rules above already do it, and the model still decides which one:
   `pro` keeps the left maid, anything else keeps the right/vision one, so no
   state leaves the stage empty and the two features never contradict. */
html[data-dsh-whale-model='pro']
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-figures-crowded]
  :is([data-maid-character='right'], [data-maid-character='vision']) {
  translate: 100vw 0;
  opacity: 0;
}

html:not([data-dsh-whale-model='pro'])
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-figures-crowded]
  [data-maid-character='left'] {
  translate: -100vw 0;
  opacity: 0;
}

/* Flash with the glasses switch on swaps both sides for the glasses layer. The
   switch itself is declared with `visibleWhen`, so it only exists while one of
   the artwork-by-model switches is on. */
html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='flash'][data-dsh-whale-maid-flash-glasses='on']
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  :is([data-maid-character='left'], [data-maid-character='right']) {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
}

html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='flash'][data-dsh-whale-maid-flash-glasses='on']
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  [data-maid-character='vision'] {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  /* Keep both sides fitted while the model changes; visibility waits for the
     outgoing fade so all three characters share the same stationary handoff. */
  html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model]
    body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character] {
    translate: none;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity 240ms ease, visibility 0s linear 240ms;
  }

  html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='pro']
    body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character='left'],
  html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='flash']
    body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character='right'],
  html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model='flash'][data-dsh-whale-maid-flash-glasses='on']
    body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character='vision'] {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition-delay: 0s;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html[data-dsh-whale-maid-model-exit='enabled'][data-dsh-whale-model]
    body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-character] {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* The top curtain belongs to the main pane, not to the sidebar. Its two
   independently translated layers let the landing ornament leave upward
   while the lace-free workspace band drops in from above. The decor stays
   below the sidebar root's stacking context (z 2), so fixed overlays that
   extension slots mount inside it (peak/cost alerts) are never covered. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='top-trim'] {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 0 auto 0;
  z-index: 1;
  height: 76px;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  contain: paint;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-trim-layer] {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  transition: transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* The compact source retains the landing-page lace. Slight overscan keeps the
   source's transparent edge rows outside the 48px layer. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-trim-layer='landing'] {
  height: 48px;
  background: var(--maid-top-trim-art) left -2px / auto 51px repeat-x;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* At the expanded scale, the source's white embroidery starts below this
   76px layer, leaving only the navy fabric and gold horizontal rules. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-trim-layer='workspace'] {
  height: 76px;
  background: var(--maid-top-trim-art) left -4px / auto 149px repeat-x;
  transform: translateY(-100%);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-workspace]
  [data-skin-trim-layer='landing'] {
  transform: translateY(-100%);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-workspace]
  [data-skin-trim-layer='workspace'] {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-composer-motion]
  [data-skin-trim-layer] {
  will-change: transform;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-trim-layer='landing']::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  /* ConversationRoot reserves DSH's stable 8px scrollbar gutter. Center the
     ornaments on that content box, the same axis as the title and composer. */
  left: calc((100% - 8px) / 2);
  top: -1px;
  width: 80px;
  height: 42px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--maid-bow-art) center / contain no-repeat;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(4, 11, 35, 0.32));
}

/* The bottom band repeats at its native height while the center crest remains
   an independent fixed-size layer inside the conversation column. Same z
   rationale as the top curtain: below the sidebar root's z 2 context. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim'] {
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 0 0 0;
  transform: translateY(0);
  opacity: 1;
  z-index: 1;
  height: 60px;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: var(--maid-bottom-trim-art) left bottom / auto 30px repeat-x;
  contain: paint;
  transition:
    transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.78, 0.2, 1),
    opacity 160ms ease-out;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-conversation-active] [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim'] {
  transform: translateY(100%);
  opacity: 0;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-composer-motion]
  [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim'] {
  will-change: transform;
}

/* A retracted band still counts toward its column's scrollable overflow, and
   the host column is `overflow: hidden`, so any scrollIntoView inside a page
   (the plugin page after an install, for one) scrolled the whole column up by
   the band's height and exposed the frame below. `clip` keeps the clipping
   but makes the column no longer a scroll container. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] :where([class*='centerCol']):has(> [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim']) {
  overflow: clip;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim']::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: calc((100% - 8px) / 2);
  width: 94px;
  height: 54px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--maid-bottom-crest-art) center / contain no-repeat;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(4, 11, 35, 0.34));
}

/* Both curtains belong to the conversation view. On a panel page they cut
   across the plugin's own page head, its icons and its footer, and the page
   cannot reserve room for chrome it does not know about, so they retract —
   with the motion that already exists: the top band's two layers slide out
   through their own 520ms transition (bow included, it rides the landing
   layer's pseudo-element), the bottom band drops and fades with the same pair
   `[data-maid-conversation-active]` uses. The seat test is the one the reading
   sheet uses, so a page is "art-free" for exactly one reason everywhere. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-panel-page]
  [class*='centerCol']
  > [data-skin-chrome='top-trim'] [data-skin-trim-layer] {
  transform: translateY(-100%);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-panel-page]
  [class*='centerCol']
  > [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim'] {
  transform: translateY(100%);
  opacity: 0;
}

/* pointer-events does not affect painting order. Keep the semantic workspace
   header above the conversation-owned decorative layer. The entrance uses
   `backwards`, not `both`: a finished `both` animation keeps its last keyframe
   applied, and a transform there — even an identity `translateY(0)` — makes this
   header a containing block for every fixed descendant (host tooltips and the
   in-place menu/dialog overlays mounted in the session header) for the rest of
   the session. `backwards` contributes only the pre-delay frame; once the
   animation ends the header computes to no transform. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] header:has([role='tablist']) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 21;
  border-bottom: 0;
  animation: maidAtelierWorkspaceHeaderEnter 320ms 110ms backwards;
}

@keyframes maidAtelierWorkspaceHeaderEnter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-6px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-trim-layer] {
    transition: none;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='top-trim'] {
    transition: none;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='bottom-trim'] {
    transition: none;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] header:has([role='tablist']) {
    animation: none;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-workspace-row][data-maid-workspace-active]::before,
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-workspace-row][data-maid-workspace-active] > [class*='folder'],
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-workspace-row][data-maid-workspace-active] [class*='projectText'] {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* The resident conversation-header slot owns the navy band; nested panel headers keep their
   own palette. Native controls consume the paired chrome tokens below, so the
   decoration no longer needs a blanket `color: inherit` over every descendant
   div/span/button — that rule also reached in-place overlays (role=dialog or
   role=menu mounted inside this header) and overrode their own reading
   palette. Every descendant-shaped rule here carries the overlay guard. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 21;
  color: #f8f3e8;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(4, 11, 35, 0.55);
}

/* Those light, glowing labels are drawn for the navy top band that only the
   official conversation column paints. Under a plugin-replaced root layout the
   header carries that band itself. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-shell='foreign'] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header {
  background-color: var(--dsw-alias-bg-base);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header
  button:not(:where(dialog *, [role='dialog'] *, [role='alertdialog'] *, [role='menu'] *, [data-menu-material] *, [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] *)) {
  text-shadow: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header
  button:not(:where(dialog *, [role='dialog'] *, [role='alertdialog'] *, [role='menu'] *, [data-menu-material] *, [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] *)):not([role='tab']):focus-visible {
  border-radius: 4px;
  outline: 1px solid rgba(235, 204, 143, 0.86);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(6, 17, 48, 0.68);
}

/* Since 0.2.2 the tablist sits inside an unmarked tab-row wrapper, so match it
   by its own marker. The labels cross the trim's hairlines; a tight navy halo
   lifts the glyphs off them without adding a surface to the band. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header > [data-slot='conversation.session.header'] [data-conversation-tabs][role='tablist'] > button[role='tab'] {
  color: #d7def0;
  text-shadow:
    0 0 2px rgba(4, 11, 35, 0.95),
    0 0 6px rgba(4, 11, 35, 0.75),
    0 0 12px rgba(4, 11, 35, 0.6);
  transition: color 0.18s ease;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header > [data-slot='conversation.session.header'] [data-conversation-tabs][role='tablist'] > button[role='tab']:hover,
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header > [data-slot='conversation.session.header'] [data-conversation-tabs][role='tablist'] > button[role='tab'][aria-selected='true'] {
  color: #fff7e6;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='conversation.header'] > header > [data-slot='conversation.session.header'] [data-conversation-tabs][role='tablist'] > button[role='tab'][aria-selected='true']::after {
  background: var(--maid-gold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(235, 204, 143, 0.45);
}

/* Pane surfaces, matched by the AppFrame column class substrings. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] {
  --dsw-alias-scrollbar-bg-l2: rgba(205, 174, 111, 0.58);
  --dsw-alias-scrollbar-hover-l2: #e8c77f;
  position: relative;
  z-index: auto;
  border-right: 0;
  background: #0a173b;
  box-shadow:
    8px 0 34px rgba(8, 17, 48, 0.22),
    inset -1px 0 rgba(255, 245, 215, 0.82),
    inset -3px 0 rgba(226, 207, 166, 0.72);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] > div {
  isolation: auto;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 14%, rgba(91, 119, 188, 0.23), transparent 31%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16, 36, 86, 0.97), rgba(5, 14, 43, 0.96)),
    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.026) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 9px 0 16px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018),
    inset -8px 0 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26);
}

/* macOS desktop clears SidebarRoot's fill and swaps the column's for a
   translucent vibrancy tint. The maid sidebar is an opaque navy panel, and
   the root fill is what veils the sidebar mascot into a watermark; without
   it the full-colour chibi sits under the transparent session rows. Restore
   both fills. The column selector mirrors the host's non-drawer condition so
   it also outranks the host's dark-theme variant. */
html[data-platform='darwin'] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  [class*='frame']:not([data-sidebar-drawer]) > [class*='sidebarCol'] {
  background: #0a173b;
}

html[data-platform='darwin'] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='sidebar'] > [class*='root'] {
  background: var(--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] > div::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 9px 7px 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

/* Tooltip bubbles are fixed-position siblings of the rail controls. Keeping
   them out of this stacking helper prevents their delayed mount from becoming
   another row in the sidebar's column flex layout. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] > div > :not(
    [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-mascot'],
    [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-corners'],
    [role='tooltip']
  ) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Wide-sidebar tooltips can mount inside the content root above. Release only
   that root's skin-created stacking context while a tooltip is present, so
   the tooltip's native overlay layer can cross the frame without moving the
   gold chrome below the sidebar surface. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  [class*='sidebarCol']
  > div
  > [data-maid-tooltip-carrier] {
  z-index: auto;
}

/* Let the active workspace ribbon clear the gold frame (4), without lifting
   the whole sidebar or trapping native menus in a new stacking context. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] > div > :has([data-maid-workspace-active]) {
  z-index: auto;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-workspace-row][data-maid-workspace-active] {
  z-index: 5;
}
/* A fixed-size raster corner keeps the original curl detail intact while the
   straight frame segments remain free to grow with the resizable sidebar. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-corners'] {
  --maid-sidebar-frame-line-x: 1.35px;
  --maid-sidebar-frame-line-y: 1.25px;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94), rgba(190, 145, 75, 0.96), rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94)) left 62px top 8.875px / calc(100% - 124px) var(--maid-sidebar-frame-line-y) no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94), rgba(190, 145, 75, 0.96), rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94)) left 62px bottom 8.875px / calc(100% - 124px) var(--maid-sidebar-frame-line-y) no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94), rgba(190, 145, 75, 0.96), rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94)) left 8.05px top 62px / var(--maid-sidebar-frame-line-x) calc(100% - 124px) no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94), rgba(190, 145, 75, 0.96), rgba(238, 210, 153, 0.94)) right 8.05px top 62px / var(--maid-sidebar-frame-line-x) calc(100% - 124px) no-repeat;
  pointer-events: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-corners'] > [data-skin-corner] {
  position: absolute;
  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;
  background: var(--maid-sidebar-corner-art) top right / 130px 130px no-repeat;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(2, 7, 24, 0.42));
  transform-origin: center;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-corner='top-left'] {
  top: 1px;
  left: 1px;
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-corner='top-right'] {
  top: 1px;
  right: 1px;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-corner='bottom-right'] {
  right: 1px;
  bottom: 1px;
  transform: scaleY(-1);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-corner='bottom-left'] {
  bottom: 1px;
  left: 1px;
  transform: scale(-1);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] [class*='fade'] {
  background: none;
}

/* The lower ellipse follows the swag's U-shaped edge as the sidebar scales.
   End padding lets the final row scroll fully above the curved fade. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='sidebar.workspaces']
  [class*='treeBody'] > [class*='list'] {
  padding-bottom: var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height);
  /* Android WebView reads only the prefixed longhands before 120. */
  -webkit-mask-image:
    linear-gradient(#000, #000),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 100% at 50% 0, #000 70%, transparent 100%);
  -webkit-mask-size:
    100% max(0px, calc(100% - var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height))),
    100% min(100%, var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height));
  -webkit-mask-position: top, bottom;
  -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
  mask-image:
    linear-gradient(#000, #000),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 100% at 50% 0, #000 70%, transparent 100%);
  mask-size:
    100% max(0px, calc(100% - var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height))),
    100% min(100%, var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height));
  mask-position: top, bottom;
  mask-repeat: no-repeat;
}

/* Reclaim both the ornament's footer seat and the list's curved fade. The
   width rule is injected later, so scope this override to the preference. */
html[data-maid-sidebar-lace='off'] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='sidebarCol'] {
  --maid-sidebar-swag-height: 0px;
}

html[data-maid-sidebar-lace='off'] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
  [data-slot='sidebar.workspaces'] [class*='treeBody'] > [class*='list'] {
  -webkit-mask-image: none;
  mask-image: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-mascot'] {
  position: absolute;
  left: 52%;
  bottom: calc(var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height) + 94px);
  z-index: 0;
  width: var(--maid-sidebar-mascot-width);
  height: auto;
  max-height: 38%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.92;
  filter:
    saturate(1)
    brightness(1.08)
    contrast(1.04)
    drop-shadow(0 5px 12px rgba(2, 7, 24, 0.24));
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateZ(0);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='centerCol'] {
  background: transparent;
}

/* Sidebar controls use porcelain and gold instead of the stock gray system. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='logoRow'] {
  min-height: 60px;
  margin: 8px 8px 0;
  padding: 8px 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(226, 207, 170, 0.72);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(92, 119, 187, 0.26), transparent 44%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 40, 92, 0.98), rgba(7, 18, 54, 0.98));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(8, 18, 51, 0.88),
    inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(197, 164, 104, 0.2),
    0 7px 18px rgba(2, 7, 25, 0.28);
}

/* The Windows desktop titlebar moves the toggle into the caption row and
   flattens the logo row (`[data-windows-titlebar] .root .logoRow { height:
   40px; margin: 0; padding: 0 }`, which outranks the rule above), so the brand
   plate rose onto the sidebar frame's top rail. Restore the web geometry for
   the expanded column; the collapsed column keeps the host's zero height. */
html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    [class*='root']:not([class*='collapsed']) > [class*='logoRow'] {
  height: 60px;
  margin: 8px 8px 0;
  padding: 8px 8px 10px;
}

/* Reuse the product's exact 182x24 vector wordmark. Porcelain ink keeps the
   DeepSeek paths crisp on navy, while the HARNESS plate uses the same gold
   accent as the surrounding frame and knocks its lettering back to navy. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='brand'] {
  color: #f3e3c0;
  --dsw-alias-label-primary-inverted: #10204d;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='brand'] > svg {
  display: block;
  width: min(182px, 100%);
  height: auto;
  flex: none;
  overflow: visible;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(2, 8, 28, 0.72));
  transition: color 150ms ease, filter 150ms ease;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='brand'] > svg > rect {
  fill: #d7b46a;
  transition: fill 150ms ease;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='brand']:is(:hover, :focus-visible) > svg {
  color: #fff4d9;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 3px rgba(2, 8, 28, 0.82));
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='brand']:is(:hover, :focus-visible) > svg > rect {
  fill: #e6c77e;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail'] [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-corners'] {
  display: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail'] [data-skin-chrome='sidebar-mascot'] {
  display: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail'] [class*='logoRow'] {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 54px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 7px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail'] [class*='logoRow'] [class*='toggle'] {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(225, 191, 124, 0.76);
  border-radius: 50%;
  corner-shape: round;
  color: #ebd29e;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(77, 103, 169, 0.48), rgba(7, 18, 52, 0.82));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(5, 15, 45, 0.76),
    0 3px 10px rgba(1, 7, 24, 0.28);
}

/* The host swaps the rail toggle's whale mark for the panel glyph on hover
   (`.collapsed .toggle:hover .panelIcon`, plus the icon button's hover wash).
   A touch screen never gets a real hover, but it does latch one on the control
   it tapped: opening the drawer left the toggle dressed as its hover self until
   the next tap landed elsewhere — tap settings and the whale came back. Pin the
   rail's resting state on touch; a pointer device keeps the hover reveal. Every
   navigation layout shares this, because the toggle is the host's in all three. */
@media (hover: none) {
  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    [class*='sidebarCol']
    [class*='root'][class*='collapsed']
    [class*='logoRow'] [class*='toggle']:hover [class*='panelIcon'] {
    display: none;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    [class*='sidebarCol']
    [class*='root'][class*='collapsed']
    [class*='logoRow'] [class*='toggle']:hover [class*='railMark'] {
    display: inline-flex;
  }

  body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    [class*='sidebarCol']
    [class*='root'][class*='collapsed']
    [class*='logoRow'] [class*='toggle']:hover {
    background: transparent;
  }
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession'] {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-height: 58px;
  margin-block: 4px 8px;
  color: #152246;
  border-style: solid;
  border-width: 0 40px;
  border-image-source: var(--maid-new-session-art);
  border-image-slice: 0 210 0 210 fill;
  border-image-width: 0 40px;
  border-image-repeat: stretch;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: none;
  font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  box-shadow: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 9px rgba(2, 8, 28, 0.22));
  transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession']:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.06) drop-shadow(0 7px 12px rgba(2, 8, 28, 0.28));
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-slot='sidebar.session.action'] > button:has(> svg[data-icon^='dsw-icon-upload-outline-']) {
  align-self: center;
  border: 1px solid #c9aa73;
  border-radius: 50%;
  corner-shape: round;
  color: #f3dba8;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #455c88, #17294c 68%, #101d38);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1c2d4d, inset 0 0 0 3px #82765f, 0 2px 5px #060e264d;

  &:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
    color: #fff3d9;
    border-color: #ffe1a5;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #526e9d, #23385d 68%, #172746);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #ffe1a5;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession'] svg {
  color: #24345c;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
}

/* The host centres the icon and label across the whole button (`width:
   100cqw`) and, on hover, fades the mask's last 16px while the Ctrl + N hint
   takes its flex slot on the right. The stock button leaves that slot in empty
   space; between the ribbon's 40px end caps the serif label runs straight into
   it and is cut to "新会". Centre the label in the mask instead, and let the
   hint unfold from zero width so the label glides left to make room, with no
   fade over the text. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession'] [class*='newSessionContent'] {
  width: 100%;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession']:is(:hover, :focus-visible) [class*='newSessionLabelMask'] {
  -webkit-mask-image: none;
  mask-image: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession'] [class*='newSessionShortcut'] {
  max-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #5a6789;
  font-family: var(--dsw-font-family, system-ui, sans-serif);
  font-size: 12px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    max-width 180ms ease,
    margin-inline-start 180ms ease,
    opacity 150ms ease;
}

/* The host's ShortcutKeys paints its own tertiary ink on the inner `.keys`
   span (retinted pale inside the sidebar), so the ribbon ink has to reach
   every descendant, not just the outer slot and the kbd cells. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession'] [class*='newSessionShortcut'] :is(span, kbd) {
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] button[class*='newSession']:is(:hover, :focus-visible) [class*='newSessionShortcut'] {
  /* Room for a rebound shortcut longer than Ctrl + N. */
  max-width: 10em;
  margin-inline-start: 8px;
}

/* Windows desktop caption controls. With `html[data-windows-titlebar]` a
   collapsed sidebar is zero wide: the host hides the column's lists and pins
   its toggle and New Session button into the caption row as two 28px icons
   (ui-sidebar `.collapsed .toggle` / `.collapsed .newSession`, fixed at
   left 12px / 48px, centred on the titlebar). The skin's sidebar-size state
   keeps its last non-zero value there — usually `wide` — so without this
   block New Session kept the 58px ribbon button (sinking below the toggle,
   a dark icon on the navy caption, and a 50% hover wash on a 28x58 box) and
   a `rail` collapse turned the toggle into a 36px medallion. Both controls
   take one caption treatment keyed on the host's own collapse state; the
   host keeps position, size, hit area and no-drag. The column and root
   parts lift these rules over the rail control list above, whose `:is()`
   carries the settings-trigger selector's specificity. */
html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-sidebar-collapsed]
    [class*='sidebarCol'] [class*='root'][class*='collapsed']
    :is([class*='logoRow'] button[class*='toggle'], button[class*='newSession']) {
  width: 28px;
  min-width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  min-height: 28px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-image: none;
  border-radius: var(--maid-caption-control-radius);
  corner-shape: round;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
  filter: none;
  transform: none;
  color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary);
}

html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-sidebar-collapsed]
    [class*='sidebarCol'] [class*='root'][class*='collapsed']
    :is([class*='logoRow'] button[class*='toggle'], button[class*='newSession']) svg {
  color: inherit;
  filter: none;
}

html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-sidebar-collapsed]
    [class*='sidebarCol'] [class*='root'][class*='collapsed']
    :is([class*='logoRow'] button[class*='toggle'], button[class*='newSession']):is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
  background: var(--maid-caption-hover);
  color: var(--maid-caption-ink-hover);
  filter: none;
  transform: none;
}

/* One caption treatment for everything on the Windows titlebar. The desktop
   shell's 应用 / 编辑 menubar (`[data-windows-menu]`, a body child with an
   open shadow root) draws 6px rounded buttons from inherited tokens: resting
   ink is --dsw-alias-label-secondary, hover is --dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover
   under --dsw-alias-label-primary. Those resolve to the porcelain content
   palette on body, so the navy caption showed dim slate text that turned navy
   on navy under the pointer. The menubar takes the sidebar's caption palette,
   and the host's round (50%) toggle and New Session icons take the menubar's
   6px corner, so every caption control hovers with one shape and one wash.
   The caption row is navy in both themes (sidebar fill), so the palette is
   theme-independent. */
html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] {
  --maid-caption-control-radius: 6px;
  --maid-caption-ink: #d7def0;
  --maid-caption-ink-hover: #fff4d9;
  --maid-caption-hover: rgba(255, 252, 243, 0.12);
}

html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] > [data-windows-menu] {
  --dsw-alias-label-secondary: var(--maid-caption-ink);
  --dsw-alias-label-primary: var(--maid-caption-ink-hover);
  --dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover: var(--maid-caption-hover);
}

/* Minimise / maximise / close are Electron's native titleBarOverlay. The
   desktop preload colours them from a hidden probe it appends to body
   (`position:fixed; visibility:hidden; background-color:
   var(--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill); color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)`)
   and re-reads it whenever a stylesheet lands in <head>. On body the light
   theme resolves label-primary to porcelain-page navy, so the native glyphs
   were drawn navy on the navy caption. The probe has no attribute of its own;
   its inline style is the only hook, and a miss simply leaves the stock
   colours in place. */
html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    > span[style*='--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill'][style*='--dsw-alias-label-primary'] {
  --dsw-alias-label-primary: var(--maid-caption-ink-hover);
}

/* The expanded column pins the same toggle into the caption row (fixed at
   left 12px, 28px round). This only squares the corner and matches the hover
   wash; it keys on the host's collapse state like the rules above. */
html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    [class*='sidebarCol'] [class*='root']:not([class*='collapsed'])
    > [class*='logoRow'] > button[class*='toggle'] {
  border-radius: var(--maid-caption-control-radius);
  corner-shape: round;
}

html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier]
    [class*='sidebarCol'] [class*='root']:not([class*='collapsed'])
    > [class*='logoRow'] > button[class*='toggle']:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
  background: var(--maid-caption-hover);
  color: var(--maid-caption-ink-hover);
}

/* The Windows frame rounds the conversation column's top-left corner
   (`[data-windows-titlebar] .centerCol { border-radius:
   var(--dsh-windows-content-radius) 0 0 0 }`, 16px) to tuck the stock grey
   page under the caption. The skin paints one continuous palace stage behind
   the brand plate and the caption row, so the corner only clipped the
   artwork into a stray curve beside the plate. */
html[data-windows-titlebar] body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [class*='centerCol'] {
  border-radius: 0;
}

/* The lower sidebar keeps the U-shaped textile ornament independent from the
   live Plan button. Its height follows the source aspect ratio, while the
   button uses fixed raster end caps and a stretchable center slice.
   Direct-child scoping: overlay surfaces (dialogs/menus) are portaled into
   this element and must not inherit the navy-and-gold foot button face. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-sidebar-footer] {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  position: relative;
  isolation: auto;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: calc(var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height) + 82px);
  padding: calc(var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height) + 2px) 18px 22px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-maid-sidebar-footer]::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  /* The footer is inset by the host; anchor to the sidebar's gold rails
     (8.05px + 1.35px), not the footer's content width. Source x=572 is
     the clasp. Paint all 1200px before clipping the last 56px: clipping
     via background-size instead selects visibly jagged downsampling in
     the desktop renderer. */
  top: 0;
  left: calc((100% - var(--maid-sidebar-width)) / 2 + 9.4px);
  width: calc((var(--maid-sidebar-width) - 18.8px) * 1200 / 1144);
  z-index: 0;
  height: var(--maid-sidebar-swag-height);
  background: var(--maid-sidebar-swag-art) left top / 100% 100% no-repeat;
  clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% * 56 / 1200) 0 0);
  pointer-events: none;
  filter:
    brightness(1.1)
    saturate(1.04)

  --dsw-alias-label-primary: #e7ecf7;
  --dsw-alias-label-secondary: #bdc9e3;
  --dsw-alias-label-tertiary: #96a6c9;
  --dsw-alias-label-caption: #8b9bbd;
}

/* The `main` seat renders either the conversation (the skin's stage) or a
   global panel page — the plugin manager, a conversation manager, whatever the
   next plugin ships — and both arrive through the one `[data-slot='main']`
   outlet the host draws with `display: contents`. Stock gives that seat the
   column's `--dsw-alias-bg-base` as its reading floor; this skin trades that
   token away so the palace shows through, which left every panel page sitting
   directly on the artwork: card fills resolved to transparent, and small or
   toned-down labels lost the contrast they were designed against. Restoring
   the floor per plugin only covers the plugins someone has already met, so the
   sheet is keyed on the seat: an art-free page is one without the two hooks the
   conversation alone owns — `[data-phase]` on the transcript root and the
   `[data-slot='conversation.*']` seats inside it.

   The sheet hangs on the column, not on the page root. Switching between two
   keyed panels replaces the root element; a `backdrop-filter` sheet recreated
   with it re-samples its whole backdrop on every switch, and a panel whose
   first paint is a short loading line stretches it from a strip to the full
   column. The column, the artwork and the trims stay put across such a switch,
   so the sheet does too. Painting it with the column's `::before` also keeps
   the filter off every content ancestor: a filtered ancestor becomes the
   containing block of any `position: fixed` overlay a plugin draws inside its
   own page.

   Tiers: the sheet sits at 1 — above the character stage (0) and below the page
   root (2, next rule) — while the top and bottom trims (1, appended to the
   column after this pseudo-element) keep drawing over it. A panel that brings
   its own opaque floor now simply covers the sheet instead of being painted
   over by it. Host overlays portal to body and keep their own tier. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-panel-page]
  [class*='centerCol']::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: var(--maid-reading-surface);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(0.95);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* The page root only lifts; it must not carry the filter. `z-index: 2` clears
   the stage (0), the sheet (1) and the trims (1), and the stacking context
   traps nothing because host overlays portal to body. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-panel-page]
  [data-slot='main']
  > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Convert the host's header collapse into unitless progress: the page sheet
   stays continuous at rest, then the pinned bar covers the scrolling cards. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier] [data-plugin-bar][data-natural]::before {
  background: #f9fbff;
  opacity: clamp(0, tan(atan2(
    var(--plugin-header-rest-height) - var(--plugin-header-paint-height),
    var(--plugin-header-rest-height) - var(--plugin-header-compact-height)
  )), 1);
  transition: opacity 240ms ease;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-ds-dark-theme] [data-plugin-bar][data-natural]::before {
  background: #0a122a;
}

/* Host primitives spend `disabled` as a 40% opacity budget, priced against the
   opaque floor the skin gave up. On the sheet a 12px label lands near 2.6:1;
   a third more opacity keeps the state readable while still reading as
   disabled. `:where()` keeps the host and plugin rules able to outrank it. */
body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-panel-page]
  [data-slot='main']
  > *
  :where(button, [role='button']):disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail']

}

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail']

body[data-dsh-maid-atelier][data-maid-sidebar-size='rail']
    [class*='sidebarCol']
